# Nomadic Labs

> Power. Water. Signal. Code.

Nomadic Labs is the umbrella home for independent software, media, AI systems, engineering work, research, client work, and release evidence built by AnonymousNomad.

Canonical site: https://nomadic-labs.dev/

## Builder

AnonymousNomad is an independent developer with an electrical-work background who builds software, AI systems, media products, and practical technical projects.

Public themes:
- hands-on engineering
- verify-first development
- local-first systems where appropriate
- off-grid independence
- outdoors/frontier influence
- gaming and original science-fiction influence
- evidence-backed claims instead of marketing inflation

Private workstation data, credentials, personal records, and private model memory are not public website data.

## Project worlds

### Nomadic TV — /tv/

Nomadic TV is an active streaming/media platform centered on live channels, guide-driven discovery, household media, movies and shows, virtual linear channels, and curated programming.

Current public engineering truth:
- canonical integrated source observed at version 0.9.2-integrated / versionCode 11
- recent device evidence exists for integrated viewer surfaces
- current integrated physical acceptance is not claimed without a completed device acceptance battery
- hosted/public media is rights-gated
- external providers use official routes unless explicit redistribution/streaming rights permit hosting
- personal media remains private

Its Freeze-Up Alaska Broadcast / underground-TV identity remains distinct from the Nomadic Labs umbrella design.

### Nexus — /nexus/

Nexus is the ecosystem catalog and community surface for ToolNeuron / Covert Edge, Covert Desktop, Covert Engine, models, skills, plugins, workflows, connectors, themes, packages, and release metadata.

Current public truth:
- a private reference site and versioned migration handoff exist
- a real Nexus API boundary exists
- catalog structure and governed publishing flow are defined
- production users/publishers, approved public packages, model results, release artifacts, and community counts must remain empty until actually implemented and verified

Public API source:
https://github.com/AnonymousNomad/covert-nexus-api

Its visual identity remains a living binary-city / data-realm rather than a generic green-code background.

### Covert — /covert/

Covert is an active local-first governed AI developer-platform program centered on resident assistance, model/runtime control, context control, workflow/orchestration, execution authority, verification, and evidence-backed mission results.

Public source:
https://github.com/AnonymousNomad/covert-coder

Planned architecture and unfinished features must not be presented as released behavior.

### Workshop — /workshop/

Workshop is the umbrella index for:
- research
- client work
- open-source contributions
- prototypes
- verification evidence
- release records

An experiment or evidence artifact is not automatically a released product.

## Delivered client work

A recent delivered client example is the Cranes Mill Baptist Church website project, covering redesign, media and sermon integration, maps, events and giving paths, hosting migration, and production publishing.

## Site architecture

Nomadic Labs is the umbrella property. Product worlds remain distinct.

Current consolidated routes:
- / — Nomadic Labs umbrella
- /tv/ — Nomadic TV
- /nexus/ — Nexus
- /covert/ — Covert
- /workshop/ — research/client/open-source/release index

The public website registry is the source of truth for shared project descriptions and status.

## Engineering doctrine

OBSERVE -> DIAGNOSE -> REPAIR -> RERUN -> VERIFY -> CONTINUE

Public shorthand:

evidence > confidence

## Website guide

The embedded Ask Nomadic guide:
- uses Cloudflare Workers AI
- answers from the curated public Nomadic Labs registry
- distinguishes active engineering from verified/released work
- says when information is unavailable
- does not expose credentials, private files, private memories, or workstation data

## Visual direction

The final Nomadic Labs homepage is not intended to be a generic SaaS portfolio.

Direction:
- restrained professional off-grid frontier environment
- northern weather and rain
- worn electrical infrastructure and power lines
- subtle static discharge
- water and signal systems
- restrained holographic instrumentation
- original science-fiction influence
- cinematic atmosphere without copying existing franchises

Nomadic TV, Nexus, and Covert retain their own visual systems.
